title: Credo (Lassus, Missa Domine dominus noster)
desc: Orlande de Lassus, Missa Domine dominus noster, Credo. 6 voices (Superius I, Superius II, Altus, Tenor I, Tenor II, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
